scope: The restored Fenari İsa Mosque in Fatih as photographed in September 2020, including the adjacent Byzantine north and south churches, eastern apses, common outer narthex, lead-colored roofs and the later mosque minaret.

originalReview.notes: The boulevard view shows the tall single minaret, later west enclosure, stone and brick stripes, five principal grilled arches, smaller roof caps, and the large windowed drum.

quallaSearch.notes: Used the exact first-party Qualla CC0 exterior. The older dome interior was excluded because it does not show the exterior and its title and category conflict on the church identity.
